extension.name: lib_dompdf
extension.author: The Dompdf Community (packaged for Joomla)
extension.description: dompdf, the HTML to PDF converter that makes the PDFs of Alfa Commerce's sales documents. Registers the Dompdf\ namespace through Joomla's autoloader. Requires php-font-lib, php-svg-lib, masterminds/html5 and sabberworm/php-css-parser, which Alfa Commerce installs with it.
